description: Run the marketplace review of one of your functions now, as a dry run: it makes one sample call to the function, stores the report on the listing when there is one and never changes whether the listing is public. Pass function_id. The sample call spends your endpoint or provider key. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

function_id.description: The pricing function UUID: id on a list_functions result.

name: run_function_review
